description: Claude Code only: wake this conversation when its attached Codescribe mailbox receives a message. Exit 75 from cs-bus is the only wake; 0 stays silent. Any other exit is a helper failure: it surfaces on stderr as a visible hook error and appends a line to runtime/hook-failures.log, never a wake. After each tool call the probe surfaces an unannounced message inside the running turn and prints nothing otherwise. Every command drops PYTHONHOME and PYTHONPATH, so a host interpreter's variables cannot break the helper.

hooks.command:
{ err=$(env -u PYTHONHOME -u PYTHONPATH PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:/opt/homebrew/bin:/usr/local/bin:$PATH" "$HOME/.local/bin/cs-bus" --claude-code-wake 2>&1 1>&3 3>&-); rc=$?; } 3>&1; if [ -n "$err" ]; then printf '%s
' "$err" >&2; fi; if [ "$rc" -eq 75 ]; then exit 2; fi; if [ "$rc" -eq 0 ]; then exit 0; fi; d="${CODESCRIBE_AGENT_BRIDGE_HOME:-$HOME/.codescribe/agent-bridge}/runtime"; mkdir -p "$d" && printf '%s %s exit %s: %s
' "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" "--claude-code-wake" "$rc" "$(printf '%s
' "$err" | tail -n 1)" >> "$d/hook-failures.log"; echo "Codescribe: wake helper failed (exit $rc); this conversation is not woken until it is fixed; see $d/hook-failures.log" >&2; exit 1

' "$err" | tail -n 1)" >> "$d/hook-failures.log"; echo "Codescribe: wake helper failed (exit $rc); this conversation is not woken until it is fixed; see $d/hook-failures.log" >&2; exit 1

{ err=$(env -u PYTHONHOME -u PYTHONPATH PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:/opt/homebrew/bin:/usr/local/bin:$PATH" "$HOME/.local/bin/cs-bus" --claude-code-probe 2>&1 1>&3 3>&-); rc=$?; } 3>&1; if [ "$rc" -ne 0 ]; then d="${CODESCRIBE_AGENT_BRIDGE_HOME:-$HOME/.codescribe/agent-bridge}/runtime"; mkdir -p "$d" && printf '%s %s exit %s: %s\n' "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" "--claude-code-probe" "$rc" "$(printf '%s\n' "$err" | tail -n 1)" >> "$d/hook-failures.log"; fi; exit 0
